about: Young Lincoln: clean-shaven, deep-set eyes under heavy dark brows, a long nose, a plain mouth. His own face is kept as the model has it: the brows, the hollows of the eyes, the nose and the mouth are his texture's, with the folds drawn in by the bake. Only the eyes are drawn on purpose, a dark pupil in each hollow, because the texture has a smudge there. His texture also has a flat grey band across the back of his dark hair; it is folded into the brown. Nothing is laid on his low-poly mesh: it models dark eye sockets of its own. (Until faces were made clear the face was painted flat first and brows, a nose shadow and a mouth were drawn too; that read as a blank face with dots on it.)
